title: Robe Hook 2-Inch Solid Brass Wall Mount | Antique Copper | Malibu | Allied Brass
description:
Keep robes and towels off the floor and within easy reach with a compact, sturdy wall-mounted robe hook designed for everyday bathroom use in Antique Copper, which brings warm, reddish-brown tones with natural variation, perfect for rustic or craftsman-style bathrooms.

Highlights:
- Antique Copper creates an inviting, organic feel
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Coordinate your bathroom look with the Malibu robe hooks collection and transitional bathroom hardware styling
- Finish your space with versatile bath accessories available in multiple designer finish options
- Install with confidence using color-coordinated mounting hardware

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 2 in. x 2 in. x 2.64 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 4 in. x 6 in. x 10 in.
- Shipping weight: 1 lb.
- Wall-mounted installation
- Assembled in the USA
- Limited Lifetime Warranty
